title: 日元急升：不是干预？，央行鹰派言论引爆
speaker: Mark Ranfield

segments.en: To be or not to be a yen trader, that's the question. Difficult one for people in the market there.
segments.zh: 做不做日元交易，这是个问题。市场人士面临两难。

segments.en: I suspect they did not, typically when there is intervention, you would expect a dollar yen to move at least four to five hundred pips, they moved about two hundred.
segments.zh: 我怀疑并非干预。通常干预时，美元兑日元会波动四五百点，而这次只动了约两百点。

segments.en: So probably not intervention, but the market obviously was jittery, and it all started with comments from the Bank of Japan's Takata earlier in the day.
segments.zh: 所以可能不是干预，但市场明显紧张，这一切源于日本央行高田早前的言论。

segments.en: He's a known hawk, so people will be expecting him to be on the aggressive side. He's been voting in favor of interest rate hikes, which the Bank of Japan hasn't been delivering very consistently, but he still insists that's the right direction to go.
segments.zh: 他是知名的鹰派，人们预期他会偏激进。他一直投票支持加息，而日本央行并未持续跟进，但他仍坚持这是正确方向。

segments.en: And yesterday, when he was speaking, he floated two ideas, which were new in the context of what we've been hearing recently, one was that the Bank of Japan may consider more than 25 basis points, so he was implying it could be 50 basis points or something like that.
segments.zh: 昨天他讲话时提出两个新想法：一是日本央行可能考虑加息超过25个基点，暗示可能达到50个基点。

segments.en: All they would even do back-to-back interest rate hikes September and October, which again is something which not many people have been taking very seriously.
segments.zh: 甚至可能在九月和十月连续加息，这一点此前很少有人认真对待。

segments.en: So two things for you and traders to consider, and that was certainly enough for them to start buying the currency yesterday, when there wasn't too much else going on in the foreign exchange world, so that gave them a good excuse to do it.
segments.zh: 所以有两点值得交易者考虑，这足以让他们昨天开始买入日元，当时汇市没有太多其他事件，这给了他们一个好理由。

segments.en: It's also the week before Labor Day, traditionally a lot of senior traders are off on the end of their holidays, so it would have been a pretty good opportunity for people to push the market around.
segments.zh: 而且劳动节前一周，传统上许多资深交易员休假，这为市场推动提供了好机会。

segments.en: So more likely, some large positions were unwound rather than actual intervention, so at least enough to get people excited.
segments.zh: 所以更可能是大规模头寸被平仓，而非实际干预，但足以让市场兴奋。

segments.en: And when you consider the context that we are coming towards that Bank of Japan meeting, we've got a chance for the next couple of weeks for traders probably to push the yen stronger, particularly on cross rates against the euro, maybe against the pound, a bit more difficult against the US dollar, but certainly there's room for the yen to appreciate if people think that this is a meeting where they will at least discuss a bigger interest rate hike than just 25 basis points.
segments.zh: 考虑到日本央行会议临近，未来几周交易者可能推动日元走强，尤其是兑欧元和英镑，兑美元稍难，但如果市场认为会议将讨论更大幅度加息，日元仍有升值空间。

segments.en: So certainly there's room for the yen to appreciate if people think that this is a meeting where they will at least discuss a bigger interest rate hike than just 25 basis points.
segments.zh: 所以如果市场认为会议将讨论超过25个基点的加息，日元确实有升值空间。
